name: allmail
description: Mail for agents over IMAP/SMTP: Gmail, iCloud, Zoho, Fastmail, any IMAP/SMTP host, and each agent's own self-hosted mailbox. Credentials by keychain/vault reference; send and trash are high-risk and need a human approval (the 'human click').

tools.name: mail_list
tools.description: List recent messages in a folder of the caller's mailbox

tools.name: mail_send
tools.description: Send a message (needs a hash-bound human approval)

tools.name: mail_trash
tools.description: Move a message to Trash (needs a hash-bound human approval)
